description: Structural gate. Validates campaign.json against required schema fields (meta, source, hub, spokes, assets, comment_cascade, review) and verifies all content_file and asset file references exist on disk. Machine-actionable (JSON + exit codes) for use by validate-campaign.py meta-harness.
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=valid, exit 1=BLOCK (missing fields or files), exit 2=WARN (unreadable).

files.HOW.py: Structural validation gate — check schema fields and file existence
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — detect past schema violations at distribution time
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signal schema_drift if block rate exceeds 20%

complementary: skills/social-distribution-engine/campaign-schema/validate-campaign.py — comprehensive human-readable report; this rule provides machine-actionable exit codes for CI.
